title: Art. 15.1.1.3 — Procedures for Air Navigation Services - Air Traffic Management (Doc 4444), Chapter 15 - Procedures Related to Emergencies, Communication Failure and Contingencies, 15.1 Emergency Procedures, 15.1.1 General, 15.1.1.3
content: Changes of radio frequency and SSR code should be avoided if possible and should normally be made only when or if an improved service can be provided to the aircraft concerned. Manoeuvring instructions to an aircraft experiencing engine failure should be limited to a minimum. When appropriate, other aircraft operating in the vicinity of the aircraft in emergency should be advised of the circumstances.
